name: Deficit Handstand Push Up
instructions: Stand with your hands on two sturdy blocks or plates and kick up into a handstand against a wall.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your head slowly down between your hands until it is below hand level.
Press back up powerfully to full lockout.
Come down from the handstand carefully.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A handstand push-up from a raised surface that increases the range of motion for the shoulders and triceps.
